title: Slapper's Random Modpack
description: This is basically vanilla Minecraft, but with a bunch of small tweaks and upgrades that just make everything feel better. FPS and performance mods keep things smooth, shaders and lighting make the world look alive, and QoL stuff like better inventory, etc.
body:
This is basically vanilla Minecraft, but smoother, easier to play, and a bit more interesting. Performance mods keep FPS stable, visual mods improve lighting and effects, and QoL mods make inventory, controls, and chat simpler to manage. Survival is improved with better farming, cooking, seasons, potion stacking, and climbing. Villages feel more alive with trading, pickup, and naming tweaks, and exploration has a few extra surprises with loot and new areas. Multiplayer is easier with voice chat and chat privacy features.
